title: Borsuk-Ulam Type Theorems and Mountain Climbing Problem
summary: In this paper, we present a new qualitative extension of the Hopf theorem (and a generalization of Borsuk-Ulam theorem), concerning continuous maps $f$ from a compact Riemannian manifold $M$ of dimension $n$ to $\mathbb{R}^n$. We remove the assumption of a Riemannian structure and instead consider closed triangulable manifolds $M$ equipped with a topological notion of 'distant' points. We show that for any continuous map $f \colon M \to \mathbb{R}^n$, there exists a connected component in the space of $f$-neighbors (where a pair of points $a, b$ are $f$-neighbors if $f(a) = f(b)$) that…
